outcome: causes of maternal death (preeclampsia and eclampsia, hemorrhage)
cohort: All cases of maternal death that occurred at the Souissi Maternity Hospital in Rabat between January 2018 and December 2021 were included.
finding: The Maternal Mortality Rate at Souissi Maternity Hospital was 156.03 deaths per 100,000 live births from 2018-2021, significantly increasing from 88.84 to 261.49 between the 2018-2019 and 2020-2021 phases, with preeclampsia/eclampsia and hemorrhage identified as the leading direct causes.
